description: Import a list of new employees into the Jolly Lobby Track database. A CSV file containing 5 new intern records is located at '~/Documents/interns.csv'. Use the application's import functionality (or manual entry) to add these employees to the Host/Employee list. Map the CSV fields 'Full Name' to Name, 'Dept' to Department, and 'Email Address' to Email. Verify that all 5 employees are present in the system after the operation.
